title: API: a Vendor Order Management user with Inventory View gets untracked parts for search tracked, no status
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as the user with Vendor Order Management + Part Library & Inventory → View. Data: QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 (untracked, active). Setup as (a): New Inventory Part, Description "QA S6 inactive untracked", Part Number "QA-S6-INU-{run}", Category, Cost, switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off, Save; reopen it, pick Part Status Inactive (radio_part_status_inactive), Save, then Deactivate in "Deactivate part?" (toast "Part deactivated."). Product decision A (SV-10819 comment 79426): the tracking words stay in the shared search, including the vendor Return and Credit pickers.
custom_steps:
1. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?search=tracked (no status parameter).
  2. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?search=tracked&status=active.
  3. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?search=track (no status).
  4. Go to Parts → Returns → Create Return and type tracked in the part field.
  5. Go to Parts → Returns → Create Credit and type tracked in the part field.
custom_expected:
1. 200; the rows include every untracked part, active and inactive (QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 and QA-S6-INU-{run} with is_active false), since status defaults to all.
  2. 200; the untracked active parts only; QA-S6-INU-{run} is left out.
  3. 200 with ordinary matches only; an untracked part appears only if its own fields contain "track".
  4. The untracked parts are offered.
  5. The untracked parts are offered.
